brand_identity.name: PrintDrop
brand_identity.core_concept: Solution SaaS européenne de gestion de commandes d'impression et portail client QR Code sans contact pour imprimeries, reprographies, cybercafés et centres de services documentaires.
brand_identity.voice_tone: Européen mature, professionnel, précis, rassurant, orienté efficacité métier et clarté.
forbidden_patterns: No generic AI purple/violet gradients (#7351B7 banned)
No invented client testimonials or fake metric statistics
No full-screen heavy dark blankets or muddy glassmorphism
No placeholder URLs or broken images
No non-semantic HTML selects or unlabelled form inputs

logo_guidelines.concept: PrintDrop wordmark + document sheet with folded corner + 3-point QR finder matrix + subtle downward print drop/arrow accent.

svg_construction.mark_geometry: Document rectangle (viewBox 0 0 48 48) with top-right 45-degree fold cutout (path: M12 6 H30 L40 16 V42 H12 Z). Inside the document: upper-left QR finder square (8x8 with 4x4 inner dot), upper-right mini QR node (4x4), and bottom-center dynamic droplet/arrow in vibrant Cyan (#08BBD0) dropping onto an output tray line in Primary Blue (#0868EF).
svg_construction.wordmark: Text 'Print' in bold Navy (#09265C) + 'Drop' in vibrant Primary Blue (#0868EF) with a subtle Cyan dot above the 'i' or on the 'o' accent.

variants.horizontal_light: Navy text + Blue/Cyan icon on Light/White background
variants.horizontal_dark: White/Cyan text + Light Blue/Cyan icon on Dark Navy background (#071A3D)
variants.compact_icon: Document sheet badge with QR dots + drop motif in 40x40 or 32x32 container
variants.favicon_app_icon: 32x32 rounded-lg (radius 7px) background #09265C with #08BBD0 folded document + #0868EF drop
variants.monochrome: Pure Navy (#09265C) on light or Pure White (#FFFFFF) on dark

svg_construction.decorative_qr_rule: The QR aesthetic is purely geometric and motif-driven (finder eyes and modular dots). It MUST NOT look like an accidental fake scannable QR code on the logo mark.

typography.pairing_strategy: The Soft Utility & European Modernism (Outfit for crisp architectural headings + DM Sans for pristine legibility + JetBrains Mono for order numbers & pricing math)

entry_surfaces./: split hero — brand headline + CTA + key trust metrics left, interactive live QR & instant price calculator simulation card right on subtle deep navy grid canvas
entry_surfaces./login: branded split login — European printing SaaS positioning panel left with security & RGPD guarantees, clean white auth card right
entry_surfaces./register: branded split register — onboarding benefit milestones left, multi-step shop registration card right
entry_surfaces./kiosk: mobile-first customer QR upload portal — shop identity header top, streamlined file drop zone + print options (format, couleur, copies) + real-time price bar bottom
entry_surfaces./track: customer order tracking page — order timeline progress bar top, shop contact and pickup PIN badge center
entry_surfaces./app/orders: shop command-center dashboard — status KPI metric cards top, high-density real-time orders data table with instant print & status triggers center

homepage_structure.content: Headline: « Votre imprimerie. Plus intelligente. Plus rapide. Digitale. » Subtitle: « Permettez à vos clients d'envoyer leurs documents directement depuis leur smartphone. Simplifiez les commandes d'impression, gagnez du temps au comptoir et modernisez votre activité. » CTAs: « Essai gratuit » (data-testid='hero-cta-trial') + « Réserver une démo » (data-testid='hero-cta-demo'). Right side: Interactive Mockup of PrintDrop QR scan & instant price quote computation.

steps: 1. Le client scanne le QR code en boutique (aucun compte ni appli requise)
2. Téléversement de PDF, Word, Images & calcul instantané du tarif selon vos règles
3. Réception automatique dans votre file d'impression & notification au client

motion_and_interactions.philosophy: Subtle, purposeful and restrained European enterprise motion. No flashy bouncing or unnecessary 3D clutter.
motion_and_interactions.hover_effects: 150ms ease-out transitions for scale (0.98 click, 1.01 hover on interactive cards), border color illumination.
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Subtle opacity and upward translation (y: 6px to 0, duration: 0.25s).
motion_and_interactions.reduced_motion: Wrap animations with prefers-reduced-motion media query checks.

contrast_verification.cyan_accent_usage: Always used with Dark Teal (#042F2E) text for 7.8:1 contrast or as subtle background tint #E0F7FA with #0E7490 text.

accessibility_and_wcag.testing_attributes_contract: All actionable controls (buttons, links, inputs, selects, tabs, forms, modals) MUST carry explicit kebab-case data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent.summary: Implement the complete visual design refresh of PrintDrop using the defined brand tokens, French copy, custom SVG logo, and pristine responsive UX.
action_checklist: 1. Update /app/frontend/src/index.css with font imports (@fontsource-variable/outfit, @fontsource-variable/dm-sans, @fontsource-variable/jetbrains-mono) and CSS color variables mapping to the European SaaS palette.

2. Create a high-quality SVG Logo component at /app/frontend/src/components/PrintDropLogo.tsx supporting horizontal, compact, dark, and icon-only modes with the document fold + QR motif + blue/cyan drop.

3. Redesign /app/frontend/src/pages/Landing.tsx with all required sections: Professional Navbar, Hero with exact French headlines, Bento 3-step workflow, features bento, dashboard live preview, 3-tier pricing (19€ / 39€ / 79€ with 14-day trial), FAQ, Contact demo form, and complete French legal footer with SIREN 800646697 and Orgères address.
4. Upgrade /app/frontend/src/pages/CustomerPortal.tsx into a frictionless mobile-first QR upload experience with real-time price calculator, file drag zone, and instant order tracking transition.
5. Polish the shop dashboard views (/app/frontend/src/pages/dashboard/*) with the 260px Navy sidebar, structured KPI cards, status badges with verified contrast, and clean order dispatch actions.
6. Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements for test automation stability.
